text: Cycling is a fun and healthy way to get around. To make sure you have a smooth ride, you need to use proper cycling equipment. First, you need to make sure you have good brakes. Brakes are what slow your bike down when you want to stop. If your brakes are not working well, you may need to replace them. Second, make sure you have good tires. Tires are what give your bike its support. If your tires are worn out or not inflated properly, they can make it difficult to ride your bike. By using good brakes and tires, you can have a safe and enjoyable cycling experience.
